response: Older patients who refuse to participate in a self-management intervention in the Netherlands do differ from those who agree to participate. The main differences are related to physical mobility restrictions, travel distance, and availability of emotional support. These factors contribute to the high refusal rate often seen in such studies. To improve the recruitment process, it may be helpful to offer solutions such as transportation to the intervention location, making it more accessible and convenient for older patients with mobility issues or those who live far away.
